project_specification.addition_summary: The v2 guided-themes test failed (docs/preregistration/2026-10-13-m2-guided-themes.RESULT.md). Five themes had in-sample IC in their stated direction: - attention-volume - funding-crowding - low-volatility - oi-price-divergence - intermediate-momentum None survived costs as a standalone signal. On 2026-10-13 the owner approved a tenth root, multi-theme-composite: one signal that equal-weights those five, each in its stated direction. The aim is breadth (IR ≈ IC·√breadth). This spec adds the root to both committed legal sets, with its brief, so the prompt renders it and a campaign can plant it.

existing_context.test_baseline: main at the commit carrying this spec: gate 1666 passed; signal-agent 845; discovery 678.
existing_context.conventions: Follow CLAUDE.md. - packages/signal-agent/src/signal_agent/legal_themes.json holds the nine v2 entries (slug, title, and a brief with mechanism, inputs, expected_sign and notes) plus construction_rules. It was compiled by _themes.py (additions_spec_guided_themes.xml, 7555c12). - _authoring_prompt.py renders the node's brief as task.theme_brief. - discovery/themes.py DEFAULT_LEGAL_THEMES mirrors the committed slugs, in order. tests/test_theme_sets_agree.py checks they agree. - Tests pin the count nine in: - signal-agent test_themes.py and test_prompt_theme_brief.py - discovery test_themes.py - tests/test_theme_sets_agree.py

category.name: Hypothesis Space
category.feature: System commits multi-theme-composite as the tenth legal theme with its brief, so that the committed set returns ten slugs and a multi-theme-composite node's prompt displays the composite brief. - legal_themes.json appends a tenth entry after intermediate-momentum: - slug: multi-theme-composite - title: "Equal-weight composite of the five in-direction v2 themes" - brief.mechanism: "Each of attention-volume, funding-crowding, low-volatility, oi-price-divergence and intermediate-momentum showed in-sample IC in its stated direction, too small to survive costs alone. They are only partly correlated, so an equal-weight combination raises breadth (IR ≈ IC·√breadth) and averages out the turnover of each component." - brief.inputs: "Build each component as its own brief describes (bars, funding_1d and metrics_1d), oriented to its stated sign. Cross-sectionally z-score each on the date, average the five with equal weights, then rank. Symbols missing a component's input take the average of the components they have." - brief.expected_sign: "Positive on the composite (each component already oriented to its own stated sign)" - brief.notes: "Weights are pre-registered as equal. Never fit them to returns. A child may change windows or smoothing, or use a longer EMA on the composite to cut turnover. Dropping or reweighting a component is a different hypothesis and must say so. basis-premium, taker-flow-persistence, beta-to-btc and positioning-contrarian are excluded (wrong sign or weak in the v2 test)." - The _comment notes the owner's approval of the tenth root (2026-10-13) and cites the v2 RESULT file. - Count pins become ten. Order pins keep the nine v2 slugs in order, with multi-theme-composite last. A test in test_prompt_theme_brief.py asserts that the rendered prompt for a multi-theme-composite workspace contains the five component slugs and "equal". - The signal-agent member suite passes under pytest-xdist.

System plants multi-theme-composite roots, so that `NULLIUS_LEGAL_THEMES=multi-theme-composite ./run.sh campaign` returns roots whose theme_root is multi-theme-composite, and the default set returns all ten slugs. - DEFAULT_LEGAL_THEMES appends multi-theme-composite, matching the committed order. The docstring notes the tenth root. - Count pins become ten, in discovery's test_themes.py and tests/test_theme_sets_agree.py. The agreement test still checks that the two sets are equal in order, and that every slug has a brief. - discovery's test_themes.py adds a case: with NULLIUS_LEGAL_THEMES set to multi-theme-composite, legal_themes_from_env() gives exactly that slug, and assign_theme admits it. - The discovery member suite and root tests/ pass under pytest-xdist.
